# Bundled CLI notice

`autohand-code-cli-v0.9.7.LICENSE` is the license from the `v0.9.7` tag in
`https://github.com/autohandai/code-cli`, matching the CLI pinned by this
application's `package.json` and vendored `BUILD_INFO.json`.

It was read with `git show v0.9.7:LICENSE` from a checkout whose origin is that
repository. The file is Apache-2.0, with SHA-256
`1490fbb717f9c3d21419aec21d1ca9287c9551b0f4ec2f209ecc24d1523949d3`.

Staging uses this notice only for the matching pinned version. A newer CLI
pin needs the corresponding release's notice; the current checkout's license
is not substituted for an older binary's license.
